definitions.gloss: appointment; promotion; recruitment to a position
definitions.explanation: Selecting and appointing someone to an important position, especially recognizing talent and giving them responsibility. Often implies promoting someone based on merit rather than seniority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登用|とうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理職|かんりしょく}→管理職：21834_kanrishoku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登用|とうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The appointment of women to management positions is progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実力|じつりょく}{主義|しゅぎ}→実力主義：17836_jitsuryokushugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{登用|とうよう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In a meritocratic company, talented people are promoted regardless of age.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {登|とう} (ascend, rise) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (employ, use). Used as a suru verb ({登用|とうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Implies selecting people based on ability and giving them important roles. Common in business and political contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登用|とうよう} (recruitment of talent)
- ⟦{抜擢|ばってき}→抜擢：07946_batteki⟧{登用|とうよう} (selection and appointment based on merit)
- {登用|とうよう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (appointment examination)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抜擢|ばってき}→抜擢：07946_batteki⟧: selection based on merit — implies choosing someone exceptional, often skipping over others
- ⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧: promotion — moving up in rank within an organization
- ⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧: appointment — officially assigning someone to a role
